dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Would you like to buy some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: It's as fresh as always, Lantern Rite notwithstanding!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: The price is also the same as always! One for three hundred Mora, or three for a thousand.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Would you like to buy some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Get one for three hundred Mora, or three for a thousand.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Shouldn't buying more mean a better price?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: It's my fish, I'll do as I wish!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: These fish are as fresh as they come! Buy one and it's good for you. Buy two and that's a deal. Buy three and you're practically stealing from me! More sales means more Mora, got it?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Besides, the more fish I sell means the fewer fish I have, and fewer fish means a higher price. Don't you get the principle of "limited supply"? These are fair prices.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: I have only one thing to say to people like you: either buy something or scram!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: No, thank you. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Just looking? Hah, your loss!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Let's buy some fresh fish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Fine, you've got yourself a bargain. But all sales are final!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: How was business today, brother?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Here, let's just say this is a token of my appreciation, all thanks to your plan!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Haw-haw, they won't suspect a thing. This is all going just as I planned it would.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: That's my Uncle Gao! There's no way anyone would ever remotely suspect that we're in cahoots. As soon as they compare our prices, they'll surely think that I'm the only one getting any business.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Come now, Uncle Sun! Bottoms up!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Here, let me fill that up for ya!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Aye! Tonight will be a night that we never remember, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Enough talking, now drink up!
